newsitem.title: CANADA: Northern Telecom says wins Chile contract.
newsitem.headline: Northern Telecom says wins Chile contract.

text.p: Northern Telecom Ltd said on Monday it won a contract from Chile's VTR S.A. to deploy a nationwide cable telephone network using Arris Interactive's product, Cornerstone Voice.
The project is due to be completed over six years, with an expected value to Nortel of US$180 million in revenues.
VTR, owned by Grupo Luksic and Southwestern Bell Corp, will invest up to US$300 million in the project. Phase one will begin in early 1997 in Santiago.
VTR expects to add more than 350,000 lines to Chile's existing telephone base after the hybrid fiber coax (HFC) network is expanded to the rest of the country.

Telephone service over the cable infrastructure will be supported by the Cornerstone Voice system, which is manufactured by Arris Interactive, a joint venture of Nortel and ANTEC Corp, Cornerstone is distributed to the international market by Nortel.
